name: WdUpdateStyleListBehavior
description: Specifies the behavior Word should take when updating a style to match a selection that contains numbering or bullets.

constants.name: wdListBehaviorKeepPreviousPattern
constants.description: Keeps the existing numbering or bullets pattern for all other paragraphs that use the same style and does not apply the numbering or bullets pattern of the selection.

constants.name: wdListBehaviorAddBulletsNumbering
constants.description: Adds the numbering or bullets pattern of the selection to all paragraphs in the document that use the same style.
